headline: Unconfirmed as new: the Cummins 'hyperscaler deal and raised outlook' item comes from a Q3 earnings preview article, with no company release found
reasoning: Source: Benzinga 14:02 ET, relaying Barchart's 'What to Expect From Cummins' Q3 2026 Earnings Report'. Quoted summary: 'Cummins CEO Jennifer Rumsey disclosed a major multiyear supply agreement with a hyperscaler ... the company has upgraded its full-year 2026 revenue growth outlook to a range of 10% to 13%.'

No Cummins press release, 8-K or Benzinga newsdesk item on a new hyperscaler contract or guidance change appears in the feeds today. An earnings preview usually recaps what management said last quarter. I could not open the Barchart page (blocked), and the web search tool is out of credits, so I cannot confirm the date of the disclosure. I treat it as unconfirmed and probably a recap.
The market agrees: CMI 523.13 vs 524.09 in the bar before the item, -0.18% on 536 IEX shares. A new hyperscaler contract with a guidance raise mid-session would not leave a $72B stock flat.
objections: Not confirmed as new; the source is a preview article, and the price has not reacted.
